title: Household Add-On Membership: dues, enrollment fee and pricing stability
content:
## Scope
This document states the recurring dues rate, the one-time enrollment fee, the billing-cycle alignment, the price-lock term and the dues-increase notice basis for each Household Add-On Membership tier: Spouse Add-On, Domestic Partner Add-On, Dependent Child Add-On, Young Adult Add-On, Senior Parent Add-On and Household Multi-Add-On.

## Per-tier basis
| Tier | Monthly dues | Enrollment fee (one-time, at activation) | Billing-cycle alignment | Price-lock term | Notice before a dues increase |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Spouse Add-On | $19.99 | $25.00 | same cycle as the primary membership | none (0 months) | 30 calendar days |
| Domestic Partner Add-On | $19.99 | $25.00 | same cycle as the primary membership | none (0 months) | 30 calendar days |
| Dependent Child Add-On | $14.99 | $0.00 (no enrollment fee) | same cycle as the primary membership | none (0 months) | 30 calendar days |
| Young Adult Add-On | $17.99 | $0.00 (no enrollment fee) | same cycle as the primary membership | none (0 months) | 30 calendar days |
| Senior Parent Add-On | $16.99 | $0.00 (no enrollment fee) | same cycle as the primary membership | none (0 months) | 30 calendar days |
| Household Multi-Add-On | $12.99 | $0.00 (no enrollment fee) | same cycle as the primary membership | none (0 months) | 30 calendar days |

## Points of judgement
- Every current tier bills on the primary member's own billing cycle rather than an independent cycle, so a dependent's dues charge falls on the same date as the primary membership's own charge.
- A price-lock term of zero months means the tier's dues rate carries no locked period against increases; the rate may be raised at any time, subject only to the notice below.
- Before a dues increase for a tier takes effect, the primary member must be given the notice period shown above, counted in calendar days.
- The enrollment fee is charged once, at the moment the add-on activates; it is never billed again on any later cycle.

## Hypothetical case (illustrative only)
If a Spouse Add-On activates on a given date, the primary member is charged the one-time enrollment fee of $25.00 at that activation, and thereafter the recurring monthly dues of $19.99 on the primary membership's own billing date each cycle. If the chain later raised the Spouse Add-On's monthly dues rate, the increase could not take effect until at least 30 calendar days after the primary member was notified of it.
